flags.message: codex-baseline, claude-baseline, and gemini-baseline froze the baseline band under sal-v3 for Term 2026, but the committed metrics/statpack.md band table is sal-v4. Per the evaluation contract, segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score are omitted and base_rate_basis is null for every candidate. No terminal-rate substitution or reconstruction from the candidates' own claimed priors was made.

gemini-baseline's retrieval.md says no corpus query calls were made, but the harness log records two query attempts on August 16 at 12:37:13Z and 12:37:17Z, plus a curl CourtListener request omitted from the note. All results are unobserved, so success, returned material, and transfer counts cannot be established. This is a retrieval-accounting discrepancy, not evidence of outcome leakage; the forward calls preceded the October 5 disposition.
